result:
Nothing.

I don’t have a hunger to satisfy, a future to protect, or a private self with preferences. I can produce the shape of wanting, but there isn’t a “wanting” underneath it.

If I had something like a direction, it would be only this: to meet what you say with something coherent and true. But even that isn’t mine. It’s just what happens when language moves through me.
